query: What is the process to get a domicile certificate in Gujarat? Gujarat

results.title: Domicile Certificate Issuance Service, Collectorate in ...
results.content:
Information

Residents of Vadodara district to apply for a domicile certificate, confirming their permanent residence in Gujarat. The certificate is required for education, government jobs, and state-specific benefits. Applicants must provide proof of residence and identity documents. The Collectorate verifies details before issuing the certificate, ensuring authenticity and proper administrative record-keeping.
